bundle.shortDescription: A modern, lightweight text editor with a minimalist design.
bundle.longDescription: Notepads for Linux is a Fluent-design text editor with a built-in tab system, session restore, encoding detection, Markdown-ready plain text editing and a keyboard-first workflow. It is an independent Linux remake of the Windows Notepads app.
bundle.copyright: MIT licensed. Independent remake of Notepads by Jackie (Jiaqi) Liu.
